Name: AutomateChests
Author: SinZ163
Description:
A small mod which requires spending hoppers to allow a chest to participate in an Automate machine group.

Currently the process of using this mod is interacting with chests while holding a hopper, and that will turn it into an automated chest.

When you want to turn it back to a regular chest and be refunded the hopper, simply interact with the chest again with an [b]empty[/b] hand.
Feel free to change the colour of the chest, it simply visual feedback and is not used for tracking the chest.

As of 1.1.0 I expose a config option now to change it from hopper to any other object or bigcraftable. Untested behavior what happens in multiplayer if the config is different between players, I recommend keeping it the same.


[youtube]s9TFQ6ieyFI[/youtube]


A known issue is that the ChestsAnywhere configuration is always present even when the chest isn't capable of being in a machine group.
